title: "Semipalatinsk Nuclear Weapons Proving Ground, 22 August 1957" – U-2 aerial photo
description: Black-and-white U-2 aerial reconnaissance photograph of the Semipalatinsk test site, showing a network of roads and test structures on open steppe with small annotation labels, a frame identifier and a "U-2" tag in the corner. Captioned "Semipalatinsk Nuclear Weapons Proving Ground, 22 August 1957." The text describes the first U-2 overflights of the Soviet nuclear testing grounds on 20 and 21 August 1957 (Chapter 3, p. 138).
